pageUrl.description: Canonical page URL from page metadata

declaredPageType.description: Page-declared type from OpenGraph og:type or a recognized JSON-LD @type, lowercased for JSON-LD

httpStatusCode.description: Observed HTTP response status code, when available

depth.description: Link distance from a start URL

hash.description: MD5 hex digest of the content

bytes.description: UTF-8 byte length of the content

content.description: Inline content string. Present when this format targets the dataset (a "*-dataset" token). May co-exist with "key"/"url" when the format also targets the key-value store.

key.description: Key-value store key. Present when this format targets the key-value store (a "*-kvs" token). May co-exist with inline "content" when the format also targets the dataset.

url.description: Public URL to the key-value store item. Present when stored to a public store.

original.description: The raw page HTML. "hash" and "bytes" are always present. When an "original-*" token is in save, the raw HTML is included as "content" (an "original-dataset" token) and/or referenced by "key"/"url" (an "original-kvs" token).

images.description: Images stored in the key-value store by the save image-handling mode (imageHandling: "save") — one reference per stored image, in document order. Absent in other image-handling modes.

mechanism.description: Discovery method: "response" for Markdown returned by the page request, "alternate" for an advertised same-origin link, "negotiated" for an Accept-based refetch, or "sibling" for a .md URL probe

url.description: Source URL of the fetched Markdown representation

verbatim.description: True when the Markdown output uses the served body after removing source front matter and applying this run's layout. False when output was converted from cleaned HTML or when the record contains no Markdown output.

markdownSource.description: Identifies content obtained from an origin-published Markdown representation through enabled markdownDiscovery. Omitted for content extracted from page HTML.

errors.description: Error messages from the final attempt

retryCount.description: Number of retries before the request was abandoned
